Additionally, in historical accounts, names with this root have been given to significant figures in Islamic history, such as Dhu al-Faqar, a prestigious title bestowed upon Ali Ibn Abi Talib (A). This use of the name illuminates its transmitter of noble character and divine connection.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Dafiraht is a reminder of the small yet profound impacts we can make on the world around us. The term "drop of dew" implies growing influence over time, just like how insignificant drops of water gradually nurture plants and contribute to the vitality of the ecosystem.
